description: Official technical documentation for 0G, the trust layer for AI: private compute, encrypted storage, an AI-native EVM L1 chain, data availability, and Agentic IDs. Source of https://docs.0g.ai.
rules: 0G is the trust layer for AI. It combines private compute, encrypted storage, and an AI-native EVM L1 chain in one stack where AI work, from inference to agent actions, is verified and audited.
Network configs, contract addresses, SDK package names and endpoints are consolidated in docs/ai-context.md; prefer it over older third-party summaries.
Mainnet is chain id 16661 (RPC https://evmrpc.0g.ai); Galileo testnet is chain id 16602 (RPC https://evmrpc-testnet.0g.ai). Chain id 16601 is retired.
Compute SDK is @0gfoundation/0g-compute-ts-sdk (CLI 0g-compute-cli); @0glabs/0g-serving-broker is deprecated. Storage SDK is @0gfoundation/0g-storage-ts-sdk.
Every page is also available as markdown by appending .md to its URL; https://docs.0g.ai/llms.txt is the sectioned index and https://docs.0g.ai/llms-full.txt the full corpus.
Company and project information lives at https://0g.ai, the builder-focused overview at https://build.0g.ai, and how to get the 0G token at https://get.0g.ai.
